name: Ness Walk
positioning: Restored Grade B listed riverside hotel on the banks of the River Ness, minutes from Inverness city centre, mixing period features with contemporary art
best_for: Couples wanting a quiet riverside base within walking distance of Inverness
Travelers using Inverness as a base for Loch Ness and the Highlands

facts.text: Ness Walk sits on the leafy banks of the River Ness, minutes from Inverness city centre.
The town centre is a 10-minute walk along the riverside.
Eden Court Theatre and the Inverness Botanical Gardens are within easy walking distance.
Loch Ness is a 10-minute drive away.
Laurel Rooms are on the upper floors, with large floor-to-ceiling windows looking across the grounds or to the River Ness.
The Wellingtonia Suite has a marble bathroom with a freestanding bath, a walk-in rainfall shower and twin basins.
The Rowan Suite has south-facing windows, with remote-controlled blinds for the evening.
In the evening guests can sit in the gardens under the stars, warmed by firepits.
Torrish restaurant is set in the hotel's original drawing room, with 19th-century detailing, high corniced ceilings and river views.
Torrish takes its name from the salmon fly used on the River Ness.
The concierge can arrange a whisky tasting itinerary, a private chauffeur or a bespoke Highland experience tour.
Picnics can be set up within a 15-mile radius, with blankets, cushions and table arrangements.

highlights.text: The Wellingtonia Suite looks onto the canopy of the 200-year-old Wellingtonia tree it is named after.
There is no check-in desk: guests sit in the lounge with a glass of champagne or a soft drink while the team handles the formalities.
Cedar Rooms open directly onto private terraces with garden and river views.
Select rooms have their own outdoor firepit.
The hotel is a restored Grade B listed building that keeps its period features while embracing contemporary art and modern design.

considerations.text: Ness Walk does not have its own swimming pool or spa.
There are no family rooms or interconnecting rooms.
Overnight parking for residents is charged per car per night.
